Option Explicit
Dim f,s,p,n,log,c,sh,rf,body,rc
Set f=CreateObject("Scripting.FileSystemObject")
Set s=GetObject("winmgmts:\\.\root\cimv2")
Set sh=CreateObject("WScript.Shell")
Set log=f.CreateTextFile("C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\guest-cleanup.txt",True)
If Not f.FileExists("C:\SpitfireLogs\run-2026-10-31-18-46-25-78376\result.json") Then log.WriteLine "Blocked missing final result":log.Close:WScript.Quit 10
Set rf=f.OpenTextFile("C:\SpitfireLogs\run-2026-10-31-18-46-25-78376\result.json",1):body=rf.ReadAll:rf.Close
If InStr(body,"""outcome"":""COMPLETED""")=0 Then log.WriteLine "Blocked non-completed final result":log.Close:WScript.Quit 11
n=0
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='Spitfire.exe'")
n=n+1
If p.ProcessId<>288 Or LCase(p.ExecutablePath)<>"c:\program files\spectra-physics\spitfire\spitfire.exe" Then log.WriteLine "Blocked unexpected original":log.Close:WScript.Quit 12
Next
If n>1 Then log.WriteLine "Blocked multiple original":log.Close:WScript.Quit 13
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE ProcessId=288")
log.WriteLine "Terminate only isolated harness original PID288 after completed capture, rc=" & p.Terminate()
Next
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='mshta.exe'")
c=LCase(p.CommandLine)
If InStr(c,"c:\spitfirelogs\run-2026-10-31-18-46-25-78376\app\run.hta")>0 Then log.WriteLine "Close completed test logger pid=" & p.ProcessId & " rc=" & p.Terminate()
Next
n=0
For Each p In s.ExecQuery("SELECT * FROM Win32_Process WHERE Name='Spitfire.exe'")
n=n+1
Next
log.WriteLine "Remaining original process count=" & n
log.WriteLine "WinPcap installation retained; no physical original PC/controller accessed; original startup preferences unchanged."
log.Close
rc=sh.Run("cmd.exe /c ipconfig /all > ""C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\cleanup-ipconfig.txt""",0,True)
rc=sh.Run("cmd.exe /c route print > ""C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\cleanup-routes.txt""",0,True)
rc=sh.Run("cmd.exe /c sc query npf > ""C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\cleanup-npf.txt""",0,True)
rc=sh.Run("cmd.exe /c sc query rpcapd > ""C:\SPF_USB_VALIDATION\cleanup-rpcapd.txt""",0,True)
WScript.Quit n
